name: What is the typical cost range for a bathroom addition in the Las Vegas area?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for a bathroom addition in the Las Vegas area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a bathroom addition in the Las Vegas area can vary significantly based on factors like size, fixture choices, and complexity. A basic half-bath addition might start around $15,000 to $25,000, while a full master bathroom with high-end finishes could range from $40,000 to $70,000 or more. These estimates include labor, materials, and necessary permits. A detailed on-site consultation provides the most accurate quote tailored to your specific project needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom addition costs in Las Vegas typically range from $15,000 for a half-bath to over $70,000 for a luxury master bath, depending on size and finishes.
